headline: Nawrocki has a revolutionary project on his desk. Another veto? A litany of remarks
summary: President Karol Nawrocki has received recommendations from his advisers on the government's planned tax reform. The report suggests a further veto is likely if he follows the advice.
why: Tax legislation in Poland affects fiscal policy, corporate tax burdens and the outlook for Polish assets.
original_headline: Nawrocki ma na biurku rewolucyjny projekt. Znów weto? Litania uwag
